title: Unified NDCG/MRR telemetry for customer-sliced ranking experiments + AB hooks
creator: Ava Martin
description: Goal: Provide a unified telemetry pipeline that computes NDCG and MRR across configurable customer slices and AB variants, with low-latency ingestion for near-real-time experiment dashboards and regression alerts. Scope includes: 1) Sampling and tagging logic for live traffic to associate requests with customer prompt sets and AB cohorts; 2) A streaming aggregator that emits ranked-list signals (positions, scores, labels) and computes NDCG@5, NDCG@10, MRR@1/5/10; 3) Backfill path for historical promptset evaluations; 4) Dashboard and alerting templates for quality regressions and confidence intervals; 5) SDK changes to allow safety/PII redaction of prompt text before telemetry ingestion. Trade-offs: prefer approximate streaming metrics (with reservoir sampling and incremental aggregates) to avoid tail-latency spikes in the inference path, while providing a backfill/accuracy reconciliation job nightly. We will cap per-customer telemetry volume via token-based quotas and deterministic sampling to keep cost predictable.
comments: 2025-01-21 - Kickoff: aligned with PM (Priya Patel) on primary success metrics (NDCG@5 delta and MRR@10 absolute). Decided to treat NDCG@5 as primary for web-search style promptsets, and MRR@10 for QA flows.

2025-01-24 - Sampling plan finalized: deterministic hash on (customer_id, request_id) to assign AB cohort and sample bucket; per-customer sample rate default 5% with overrides for flagged customers. This avoids cross-customer correlation and makes storage predictable.

2025-01-27 - Implementation note: to avoid adding latency to the inference path we will emit lightweight telemetry events (ranks+ids+scores) asynchronously to an internal Kinesis topic. Transformation (join with ground-truth labels) will happen in the consumer pipeline. QA: ensure event size < 1KB for 95% of requests.

2025-01-30 - PR feedback (ENG): @Liam O'Connor requested stronger schema versioning and backward compatibility on the telemetry payload. Action: add a v2 header and a migration script for backfill consumers. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ranking-telemetry/pull/342

2025-02-02 - Privacy check: security team (Maya Singh) requested that prompt text be redacted or hashed before leaving the VPC for customers with strict PII requirements. We added SDK flag 'redact_prompt' and a config toggle in Private deployments. Impact: reduces ability to run some label-matching heuristics; mitigation: preserve tokenized feature vectors (non-reversible) for matching.

2025-02-04 - Integration test: ran a 6-hour canary on staging with 3 top-tier customers' promptsets. Metrics: NDCG@5 and MRR@10 computed in streaming pipeline matched nightly backfill within 1.8% for NDCG and 2.3% for MRR (within acceptable bounds). Observed increased Kinesis traffic ~12% — plan to enable gzip compression and batch flush windows to reduce cost.

2025-02-05 - PM review: Priya asked for per-model breakdown on dashboards. Added model_id dimension to aggregates and updated dashboard template. Next: add anomaly detection thresholds and auto-notification to owners when NDCG delta > 0.03 with p<0.05.
QA checklist: unit tests for telemetry schema, e2e test for sampling determinism, synthetic promptset backfill validate NDCG/MRR computations, load test to 5x expected production volume.
